newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Sept BTPs to chase 131.86 contract high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Sept BTPs to chase 131.86 contract high.

text.p: EMU hopes and strong charts are likely to push September BTPs higher on Wednesday and technical analysts said any pull-backs should be considered a buy.
But the contract must first resurface above Tuesday's high of 130.90 to gain momentum for a hike toward the contract 131.86 high set on May 21. Trendline support is well-built at 129.96.
Norman Beauchamp, head of derivatives at Cooperative Bank in London, said dips were possible after Tuesday's 1.15 point rally. But a retreat to below 129.48 -- the high of May 30 -- looked unlikely.
By 0730 GMT, Sept BTP traded 20 basis points down at 129.60.
"We broke the downtrend yesterday. Stochastics and RSIs have just turned back up again. We're coming from an oversold position which is quite positive," said Beauchamp.

But the September contract had outperformed the front month June by double on Tuesday, so it could stall for a while waiting for June to catch up. Initial resistance would be Tuesday's high of 130.90.
Support was first at the up trendline from April 1 at 129.96, followed by 129.48 on May 30.
"If there's any pull-back, you'll see fresh buying coming in," Beauchamp said.
Analysts at a European bank in London said the sharp rally in BTPs could soon look overbought, making it difficult for the market to stay above 131.00 in the near-term.
Chase analysts meanwhile said a break above 130.94 was needed to put a bottom in place, opening potential for a move towards 131.90.
"However, failure below the 130.94 level will keep the pressure on the downside," Chase in London said in a research note.
At 0825 GMT, the September Eurolire future stood one basis point down on the day at 93.43.
